title: SpatialASM: Internalizing Active Mentalization for Spatial Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.13832v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When solving complex spatial reasoning tasks, ordinary humans naturally revisit the scenes from task-relevant viewpoints and mentally reconstruct the spatial layouts from those viewpoints. But can Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) proactively think in the same way? We term this ability Active Spatial Mentalization (ASM), an intrinsic component of visual intelligence that remains substantially underdeveloped in current LVLMs. To bridge this gap, we introduce SpatialASM, a scalable framework to internalize ASM into LVLMs through training-time spatial simulation. translated_title: SpatialASM：将主动空间心智化内化于空间推理
translated_abstract: 在解决复杂的空间推理任务时，普通人会自然而然地从与任务相关的视角重新审视场景，并在头脑中重建这些视角下的空间布局。但大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）能否主动地以同样的方式思考？我们将这种能力称为主动空间心智化，它是视觉智能的内在组成部分，但在当前的LVLMs中仍严重欠缺。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了SpatialASM，这是一个可扩展的框架，通过训练时的空间模拟将ASM内化到LVLMs中。SpatialASM采用一种以他者为中心的新视角生成器，将假设的视角锚定在视觉证据之上，并产生两种互补形式的监督：i）显式的ASM轨迹，教导LVLMs在空间推理过程中何时以及如何自适应地调用视角规划与想象；ii）自动构建的视角采择任务，进一步强化……
tldr: 提出SpatialASM框架，通过训练时的空间模拟与新视角生成，将主动空间心智化（ASM）能力内化到大型视觉语言模型中，显著提升其空间推理能力。
en_tdlr: SpatialASM is a scalable framework that internalizes Active Spatial Mentalization (ASM) into LVLMs through training-time spatial simulation, using an allocentric novel-view generator to provide explicit ASM trajectories and perspective-taking supervision for enhanced spatial reasoning.
